capture.title: The Last Cup
capture.caption: Light hits a paper cup on a wooden table.
capture.alt: Black and white photo of a single paper cup on a grained wooden table in a dark room with a sliver of light from above.

chitta.title: The Red Cap
chitta.caption: A man in a red beanie leans over a metal tray on a stone ledge.
chitta.alt: A person wearing a red cap and brown jacket bends over a small tray of food on a stone block next to a grey car.

courage-3.title: Grain And Void
courage-3.caption: Split wood holds a deep, vertical fissure.
courage-3.alt: Black and white close-up of a weathered, textured piece of wood diagonally crossing a black background.

fate.title: River At Dusk
fate.caption: Glasses reflect the orange light of the horizon.
fate.alt: Side profile of a person wearing glasses looking at a river under a dark orange sunset sky.

flowers.title: Transit Hall
flowers.caption: Magenta petals against a polished stone floor.
flowers.alt: Four bright pink artificial flowers in a pot in the foreground of a long, empty tiled corridor.

globe.title: Glass Sphere
globe.caption: Light bends through a pitted glass ball on a wooden surface.
globe.alt: A small, textured glass sphere resting on a ribbed wooden surface, lit from behind against a black background.

howler.title: Night Watch
howler.caption: The dog sits against a pale wall in the dark.
howler.alt: Silhouette of a dog sitting on a dark pavement at night, facing a white wall and a distant street lamp.

induction.title: Glass And Flame
induction.caption: Light bends through two glass spheres on a wooden surface.
induction.alt: Two glass spheres resting on a light-colored wood grain surface against a black background, one containing a bright orange flame.

journey.title: Rear View
journey.caption: Three men sit in the back of a white pickup truck on a narrow road.
journey.alt: The back of a white pickup truck carrying three men and cargo, driving away on a paved road lined with green trees under a blue sky.

its.title: The Workshop Row
its.caption: A pink price tag hangs from the hand of a goddess.
its.alt: A line of painted deity statues under a bamboo roof with a numbered price tag in the foreground.

laughter.title: Discarded Form
laughter.caption: Paint peels from a smiling face in the dirt.
laughter.alt: A broken doll head and arm lie amidst dark soil, dry leaves, and debris.

reminder.title: Stone And Banyan
reminder.caption: Green cloth hangs behind a seated stone figure.
reminder.alt: A stone statue of a seated Buddha on a pedestal, positioned against a green fabric backdrop with banyan roots hanging above.

snoop-dogg.title: The Watchman
snoop-dogg.caption: A red and white collar sits loose on the neck.
snoop-dogg.alt: Close-up of a brown and white beagle dog wearing a red and blue collar, standing in a concrete yard before a corrugated metal shed.

view.title: Railway Yard
view.caption: Rust red and blue cars sit on parallel tracks.
view.alt: High angle view of a train yard with red freight cars and blue passenger coaches under a bright blue sky with one large cloud.

assured.title: Midday Rest
assured.caption: Eyes closed against the light.
assured.alt: Close-up of an orange tabby cat sleeping on a purple fabric surface.

bird.title: The Ledge
bird.caption: One foot is lifted from the stone.
bird.alt: Black and white photograph of a small bird perched on a dark, textured surface against a black background.

chirtmas.title: Night Watch
chirtmas.caption: Light hits the wing of a statue above a crowd.
chirtmas.alt: A statue of an angel on a pedestal at night, illuminated by a bright street lamp with people in silhouette below.

choices.title: Street Lamp
choices.caption: Light falls on a metal box and the dirt beneath a tree.
choices.alt: A night photograph of a single street lamp illuminating a tree, a metal utility box, and a patch of ground.

civilization.title: The Floating Pyre
civilization.caption: Four crows perch on a body drifting toward the shore.
civilization.alt: A body wrapped in cloth floats in a river with birds on top, while people and a fire are visible on the distant bank.

corona.title: The Swab
corona.caption: A gloved hand holds a thin white stick to a nostril.
corona.alt: A person in a face mask and gloves performs a nasal swab on a bearded man outdoors.

courage.title: Iron And Leg
courage.caption: Hairs on the legs catch the light against rusted metal.
courage.alt: Close-up of a small brown spider on a dark, rusted iron bar.

difference.title: Green In Grey
difference.caption: Green blades grow from a patch of grey soil.
difference.alt: Close-up of green grass on the left and grey, dried plants on the right, emerging from dark soil.

fast.title: Night Transit
fast.caption: One headlight cuts through the blue dark.
fast.alt: A person on a scooter drives down a dark asphalt road at night under blue streetlights.

header-banner.title: The Tool
header-banner.caption: A camera hangs by the hand against a grey sky.
header-banner.alt: Black and white close-up of a person's side and hand holding a DSLR camera, framed by rocky terrain.

hope.title: Yellow Glass
hope.caption: Light filters through amber circles in a metal frame.
hope.alt: Close-up of a glowing yellow glass lamp with a black metal filigree frame against a dark background.

ressurection.title: Night Asphalt
ressurection.caption: One white flower rests on the coarse grit of the road.
ressurection.alt: A small white flower with a yellow center on dark, textured asphalt at night with blurred car lights in the background.

riddick.title: The Cluster
riddick.caption: Red millipedes huddle together on damp grey stone.
riddick.alt: A dense mass of reddish-brown millipedes coiled together on a dark, textured rock surface.

unstoppable.title: The Sketch
unstoppable.caption: A charcoal pencil marks the eye of a face on white paper.
unstoppable.alt: Over-the-shoulder view of a person in a red shirt drawing a portrait on a sketchbook resting on stone steps.

wont-beleive.title: Green Horizon
wont-beleive.caption: The tree leaves overlap the edge of the blue sky.
wont-beleive.alt: A wide green field under a bright blue sky with white clouds, framed by green tree branches on the right.
